title: Ring Push-Up
summary: A push-up with your hands in low rings, so you can lower below hand level for a deep chest stretch and must stabilise the rings as you press.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for chest (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly chest total.
Library rating 0.6 for triceps (helper): each working set adds 0.6 of a set to the weekly triceps total.
Library rating 0.5 for front delts (helper): each working set adds 0.5 of a set to the weekly front delts total.
Library rating 0.2 for abs: below the counting floor, so it adds nothing to the weekly abs total.

setup.text: Set the rings a few inches off the floor and get into a push-up position holding them.
Lower your chest between the rings.
Press up and turn the rings out slightly at the top.

form_cues.cue: Lower your chest to the rings
Press and turn the rings out at the top
Raise your feet to make it harder.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds up to 2 ramp-up sets only when the load is heavy for the equipment and the main muscle is not warm yet.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 7.5% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 8-12 reps, stopping about 3 reps short of failure (RIR 3). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train pain-free.
